item.title: RT: 在《如何在股票中赚钱》一书中，奥尼尔将“M”（市场方向）视为决定性的过滤器：强有力
item.description:
在《如何在股票中赚钱》一书中，奥尼尔将“M”（市场方向）视为决定性的过滤器：强有力的选股无法克服总体市场的下跌。

当整体市场趋势下跌时，大约四分之三的股票将随着大盘平均水平下跌，即使这些股票具有强劲的基本面。

CANSLIM中的M非常重要！

In How to Make Money in Stocks, O'Neil treated the "M" (Market direction) as a decisive filter: strong stock selection cannot overcome a falling general market.

Roughly three out of four stocks will fall along with the broader market averages when the overall market trend is down, even if those stocks have strong fundamentals.

The M in CANSLIM is very important!

截至今天，年初至今的业绩增长了 11.2%，其中包括按销售价格计算的 $CRWV 头寸。 $CRWV 成本基础为 $88.08。

我在 2026 年出售的另外三只股票是 $SNOW、$SHOP 和 $HOOD（这三只股票均已出售以获得前几年的收益）。

2026 年我基本上保持沉默，但这导致市场年初至今平均上涨，而 70% 以上的股票今年迄今出现亏损。

I sold $CRWV today, taking the loss as I believe there are better options setting up.

$AAPL +26.3%
$NVDA +16.6%
$V +15.6%
$AMZN +13.6%
$MSFT +11.1%
$GOOGL +10.1%

$UBER -15.1% ($65.00 cost basis so a slight gain)

$ANET +39.6%
$RDDT -32.7% ($149.84 cost basis so a slight gain)

The YTD results are +11.2% through today, including the $CRWV position at the sale price. The $CRWV cost basis was $88.08.

The other three stocks I sold in 2026 were $SNOW, $SHOP & $HOOD (all three were sold for gains from prior years).

I've been mostly quiet in 2026 but it has led to an average YTD gain in a market with 70%+ of stocks showing a YTD loss.
